ownership_rule: User rules 2026-09-25/26: the project owns this database; no application (Ingest, Media Assist, Story or any other) owns it or its tables. No form or worker writes to it, so none can own it: filmstrip and wave results reach these tables only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.artifact-db owns them (lego split of the former content store, 2026-09-27).

rules.catalog: A row belongs to a clip of the catalog (clip_id refers to clips.clip_id); a wave belongs to its stored original or proxy, read through qnc-content-read.
rules.removal: Before the catalog removes a clip missing on its source, qnc-artifact-db forgets its rows (only of a detected or failed clip); a queued or imported clip keeps them.
rules.files: Filmstrip frames are JPEG files under the project products/filmstrip location; the database keeps their URIs, never the pixels.

public_filmstrip_frames.artifact_uri.specification: 13 real JPEG frame artifacts under the project products/filmstrip location from WorkSettings; no probe, no scanner, no repeated poster.

public_wave_artifacts.peaks_json.specification: Prepared peak arrays for passive timeline painting. Source and lane count come from project audio settings plus saved clip/proxy metadata: two-channel project may use proxy audio when present, original uses saved original channels in public timeline lanes. No waveform probe, no PNG sidecar, no separate wave database.
